{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders: look for order_id starting with 'TEST'
print("Test orders (order_id starts with 'TEST'):", sales_df[sales_df['order_id'].str.startswith('TEST')].shape[0])

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (~sales_df['order_id'].str.startswith('TEST'))]

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
